# NewKwLab Agent Skills

> Agent skills for four NewKwLab APIs on RapidAPI: EmailCheck (email validation and batch list cleaning), Page2MD (web page to Markdown), FoodFacts (barcode nutrition lookup), FlightScope (live flight tracking and airport data)

## Product

NewKwLab Agent Skills — five prompt-driven workflows for Claude, Cursor, and any agent runtime that reads a skills directory: one routing/reference skill plus one use-case skill per API. Every API is subscribed to on RapidAPI with the caller's own key; every call bills against that caller's subscription. There is no shared key.

## What it does

Gives your agent the data and the workflow to answer real questions:

- **EmailCheck**: "Is this email real?" / "Clean this mailing list" → per-address `valid`, `score` (0–100) and `verdict`, with MX, disposable, role-account and typo signals, `domainAgeDays` from RDAP, and a batch endpoint that cleans up to 100 addresses in ONE call with a summary report
- **Page2MD**: "Turn these links into Markdown notes" → clean Markdown with `title`, `byline`, `excerpt` per URL, single or batch, for RAG ingestion and reading lists
- **FoodFacts**: "What's in this product?" (barcode 3017620422003) → Nutri-Score, NOVA group, Eco-Score, ingredients, allergens and per-100g nutrients from Open Food Facts; keyword search with a grade filter; category browsing
- **FlightScope**: "Where is flight TS655 right now?" → airline, aircraft registration and type, and the live ADS-B position (latitude, longitude, altitudeFt, groundSpeedKt, squawk, ageSeconds); batch lookup of 100 flights in one call; aircraft near any point; 3,270 airport profiles

The differentiators are the verdict fields: EmailCheck's score comes with the evidence behind it, FlightScope's positions carry their own freshness (`ageSeconds`), and both batch endpoints turn a 100-item job into a single billed call.

## Install (60 seconds)

### MCP servers (RapidAPI hosted gateway)

One gateway URL — https://mcp.rapidapi.com — serves every API as its own MCP server, selected by the `x-api-host` header, authenticated with the caller's `x-api-key`:

```bash
claude mcp add --transport http emailcheck https://mcp.rapidapi.com \
  --header "x-api-host: emailcheck-email-validation-api.p.rapidapi.com" \
  --header "x-api-key: YOUR_RAPIDAPI_KEY"

claude mcp add --transport http flightscope https://mcp.rapidapi.com \
  --header "x-api-host: flightscope-live-flight-tracking-and-airport-data-api.p.rapidapi.com" \
  --header "x-api-key: YOUR_RAPIDAPI_KEY"
```

Page2MD (host `page2md-url-to-clean-markdown-api.p.rapidapi.com`) and FoodFacts (host `foodfacts-product-nutrition-barcodes-and-food-search.p.rapidapi.com`) use the identical shape; both hosts were copied from their listings' Playground MCP panels and verified with MCP `tools/list` calls on 2026-11-17. Hosts are verified, never guessed.

### Skills (prompt workflows)

```bash
# Claude Code plugin
claude plugin marketplace add binbin7418-dotcom/newkwlab-agent-skills
claude plugin install newkwlab-agent-skills@newkwlab-agent-skills

# Or any agent with a skills directory
git clone https://github.com/binbin7418-dotcom/newkwlab-agent-skills.git
cp -r newkwlab-agent-skills/skills/* ~/.claude/skills/
```

### Get a key

Subscribe on a listing (free tiers: EmailCheck 100 calls/mo, FoodFacts 500/mo, FlightScope 50/mo, Page2MD 100 calls/mo), then use your own RapidAPI key. One key covers every API you subscribe to.

## APIs

| Product | What | Where |
|---|---|---|
| EmailCheck | Email validation, batch list cleaning, typo fix, domain age | https://rapidapi.com/binbin7418/api/emailcheck-email-validation-api |
| Page2MD | Web page to clean Markdown, single and batch | https://rapidapi.com/binbin7418/api/page2md-url-to-clean-markdown-api |
| FoodFacts | Barcode nutrition lookup and food search (Open Food Facts) | https://rapidapi.com/binbin7418/api/foodfacts-product-nutrition-barcodes-and-food-search |
| FlightScope | Live flight tracking, batch lookup, airport data (adsb.lol, OurAirports) | https://rapidapi.com/binbin7418/api/flightscope-live-flight-tracking-and-airport-data-api |

## Design rules

1. Prefer MCP tools when available; fall back to REST otherwise
2. Say what a call costs before making it — batch endpoints make a 100-item job cost 1 call
3. A named error is an answer, not a failure (`FLIGHT_NOT_LIVE`, `PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND`, `BATCH_TOO_LARGE`)
4. Never print, log, or commit an API key
5. No invented numbers — samples are real responses, prices are the live listing prices
